Select molecule_chembl_id, molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, and canonical_smiles for compounds reported in document CHEMBL1151930. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id. Filter by doc_chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1151930'. Left join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical_smiles. Order the results by molecule_chembl_id.
